sections.title: Physical properties of organic compounds

questions.q: What are intermolecular forces?
questions.qAf: Wat is intermolekulêre kragte?

questions.q: Why were compounds with similar molar masses chosen for this comparison?
questions.qAf: Waarom is verbindings met soortgelyke molêre massas vir hierdie vergelyking gekies?
points: So that the London forces are about the same and only the functional group affects the boiling point (fair test)
pointsAf: Sodat die London-kragte omtrent dieselfde is en net die funksionele groep die kookpunt beïnvloed (regverdige toets)

questions.q: Explain the difference between the boiling points of pentanal and pentan-1-ol. Refer to the type and strength of the intermolecular forces.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die verskil tussen die kookpunte van pentanaal en pentan-1-ol. Verwys na die soort en sterkte van die intermolekulêre kragte.
points: Pentanal has dipole-dipole forces (and London forces) between its molecules
pentan-1-ol has hydrogen bonds between its molecules
hydrogen bonds are stronger than dipole-dipole forces
so more energy is needed to overcome the forces in pentan-1-ol
pointsAf: Pentanaal het dipool-dipoolkragte (en London-kragte) tussen sy molekules
pentan-1-ol het waterstofbindings tussen sy molekules
dus is meer energie nodig om die kragte in pentan-1-ol te oorkom

questions.q: Which compound in the table has the highest vapour pressure at room temperature? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Watter verbinding in die tabel het die hoogste dampdruk by kamertemperatuur? Gee ’n rede.
points: it has only London forces between its molecules (the weakest intermolecular forces)
pointsAf: dit het net London-kragte tussen sy molekules (die swakste intermolekulêre kragte)

questions.q: Explain why butanoic acid has a higher boiling point than pentan-1-ol.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom butanoësuur ’n hoër kookpunt as pentan-1-ol het.
points: Butanoic acid has two sites for hydrogen bonding (forms dimers)
so its intermolecular forces are stronger and more energy is needed to overcome them
pointsAf: Butanoësuur het twee plekke vir waterstofbinding (vorm dimere)
dus is sy intermolekulêre kragte sterker en is meer energie nodig om hulle te oorkom

questions.q: Which has the higher boiling point: hexane or 2,2-dimethylbutane? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Watter een het die hoër kookpunt: heksaan of 2,2-dimetielbutaan? Gee ’n rede.
points: hexane: it is unbranched, has a larger contact surface and so stronger London forces
pointsAf: heksaan: dit is onvertak, het ’n groter kontakoppervlak en dus sterker London-kragte

sections.intro:
Study the reactions below.
Reaction 1: propene + Br₂ → 1,2-dibromopropane
Reaction 2: propane + Br₂ (UV light) → 2-bromopropane + X
Reaction 3: 2-bromopropane + concentrated KOH in ethanol (strong heat) → propene
Reaction 4: propene + H₂O (H₃PO₄ catalyst) → propan-2-ol
sections.introAf:
Bestudeer die reaksies hieronder.
Reaksie 1: propeen + Br₂ → 1,2-dibroompropaan
Reaksie 2: propaan + Br₂ (UV-lig) → 2-broompropaan + X
Reaksie 3: 2-broompropaan + gekonsentreerde KOH in etanol (sterk hitte) → propeen
Reaksie 4: propeen + H₂O (H₃PO₄-katalisator) → propan-2-ol

sections.title: Rate of reaction

questions.q: Define a catalyst.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n katalisator.
points: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction
without itself undergoing a permanent change
pointsAf: ’n Stof wat die tempo van ’n chemiese reaksie verhoog
sonder om self ’n permanente verandering te ondergaan

questions.q: Write down the independent variable in this investigation.
questions.qAf: Skryf die onafhanklike veranderlike in hierdie ondersoek neer.

questions.q: Explain why the reaction in experiment II is faster. Refer to the activation energy.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die reaksie in eksperiment II vinniger is. Verwys na die aktiveringsenergie.
points: The catalyst provides an alternative pathway
so more particles have enough energy, and there are more effective collisions per unit time
pointsAf: dus het meer deeltjies genoeg energie, en is daar meer effektiewe botsings per eenheidtyd

questions.qAf: Eksperiment II is ná 80 s voltooi. Bereken die gemiddelde tempo van suurstofproduksie in mol·s⁻¹.

questions.q: Experiment II is repeated with 50 cm³ of 0,4 mol·dm⁻³ H₂O₂. How will this affect the rate and the final mass of oxygen?
questions.qAf: Eksperiment II word herhaal met 50 cm³ van 0,4 mol·dm⁻³ H₂O₂. Hoe sal dit die tempo en die finale massa suurstof beïnvloed?
points: the final mass of oxygen is halved (0,32 g)
pointsAf: die finale massa suurstof word gehalveer (0,32 g)

sections.intro:
Learners investigate the decomposition of 50 cm³ of hydrogen peroxide solution of concentration 0,8 mol·dm⁻³ at 25 °C:
2H₂O₂(aq) → 2H₂O(ℓ) + O₂(g)
In experiment I no catalyst is added. In experiment II a small amount of manganese dioxide (MnO₂) is added.
sections.introAf:
Leerders ondersoek die ontbinding van 50 cm³ waterstofperoksiedoplossing met ’n konsentrasie van 0,8 mol·dm⁻³ by 25 °C:
2H₂O₂(aq) → 2H₂O(ℓ) + O₂(g)
In eksperiment I word geen katalisator bygevoeg nie. In eksperiment II word ’n klein hoeveelheid mangaandioksied (MnO₂) bygevoeg.

sections.title: Chemical equilibrium

questions.q: What is meant by a closed system?
questions.qAf: Wat word met ’n geslote sisteem bedoel?
points: A system in which no substances (matter)

questions.q: Calculate the equilibrium constant K_c at 450 °C.
questions.qAf: Bereken die ewewigskonstante K_c by 450 °C.
points: initial: H₂ 2 mol; I₂ 2 mol; HI 0
change: HI +3 so H₂ −1,5 and I₂ −1,5 (1 : 1 : 2 ratio)
pointsAf: begin: H₂ 2 mol; I₂ 2 mol; HI 0
verandering: HI +3 dus H₂ −1,5 en I₂ −1,5 (1 : 1 : 2-verhouding)

questions.q: The temperature is increased. Will the value of K_c INCREASE, DECREASE or STAY THE SAME? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die temperatuur word verhoog. Sal die waarde van K_c TOENEEM, AFNEEM of DIESELFDE BLY? Verduidelik.

questions.q: The volume of the container is decreased at constant temperature. How will this affect the amount of HI at equilibrium? Explain.
questions.qAf: Die volume van die houer word by konstante temperatuur verklein. Hoe sal dit die hoeveelheid HI by ewewig beïnvloed? Verduidelik.
points: there are 2 mol of gas on each side of the equation
so a change in pressure favours neither reaction
pointsAf: daar is 2 mol gas aan elke kant van die vergelyking
dus bevoordeel ’n drukverandering geen van die reaksies nie

questions.q: A catalyst is added to the system at equilibrium. How does this affect the amount of HI? Explain.
questions.qAf: ’n Katalisator word by die stelsel in ewewig gevoeg. Hoe beïnvloed dit die hoeveelheid HI? Verduidelik.
points: a catalyst increases the rates of the forward and reverse reactions equally
pointsAf: ’n katalisator verhoog die tempo’s van die voorwaartse en terugwaartse reaksies ewe veel

sections.intro:
2 mol H₂(g) and 2 mol I₂(g) are sealed in a 2 dm³ container at 450 °C. The reaction reaches equilibrium:
H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g) ΔH < 0
At equilibrium the container holds 3 mol HI(g).
sections.introAf:
2 mol H₂(g) en 2 mol I₂(g) word in ’n houer van 2 dm³ by 450 °C verseël. Die reaksie bereik ewewig:
H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g) ΔH < 0
By ewewig bevat die houer 3 mol HI(g).

questions.q: Define an acid according to the Arrhenius theory.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n suur volgens die Arrhenius-teorie.
points: A substance that produces hydrogen ions (H⁺ / H₃O⁺)

questions.q: Explain why ammonia is classified as a weak base.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ammoniak as ’n swak basis geklassifiseer word.
points: It reacts with (ionises in) water only partially
so only a small amount of OH⁻ ions forms
pointsAf: Dit reageer slegs gedeeltelik met (ioniseer gedeeltelik in) water
dus vorm net ’n klein hoeveelheid OH⁻-ione

questions.scenario:
In a titration, 25 cm³ of oxalic acid (H₂C₂O₄) of concentration 0,1 mol·dm⁻³ is exactly neutralised by 22 cm³ of sodium hydroxide solution:
H₂C₂O₄(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂C₂O₄(aq) + 2H₂O(ℓ)
questions.scenarioAf:
In ’n titrasie word 25 cm³ oksaalsuur (H₂C₂O₄) met ’n konsentrasie van 0,1 mol·dm⁻³ presies geneutraliseer deur 22 cm³ natriumhidroksiedoplossing:
H₂C₂O₄(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂C₂O₄(aq) + 2H₂O(ℓ)

questions.qAf: Noem ’n geskikte indikator vir hierdie titrasie van ’n swak suur met ’n sterk basis.

questions.q: Calculate the pH of the sodium hydroxide solution at 25 °C.
questions.qAf: Bereken die pH van die natriumhidroksiedoplossing by 25 °C.

questions.q: Is a solution of potassium chloride (KCl) acidic, basic or neutral? Explain.
questions.qAf: Is ’n oplossing van kaliumchloried (KCl) suur, basies of neutraal? Verduidelik.
points: it is formed from a strong acid (HCl) and a strong base (KOH)
neither K⁺ nor Cl⁻ hydrolyses in water
pointsAf: dit word uit ’n sterk suur (HCl) en ’n sterk basis (KOH) gevorm
nóg K⁺ nóg Cl⁻ hidroliseer in water

questions.qAf: 10 cm³ HCl(aq) met ’n konsentrasie van 0,5 mol·dm⁻³ word met water tot 250 cm³ verdun. Bereken die pH van die verdunde oplossing.

sections.title: Electrolytic cells

questions.q: Define an electrolyte.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n elektroliet.
points: A substance whose solution or melt conducts electricity
pointsAf: ’n Stof waarvan die oplossing of smelt elektrisiteit gelei

questions.q: Name the gas that forms at the anode.
questions.qAf: Noem die gas wat by die anode vorm.

questions.q: Write down the half-reaction at the cathode.

questions.q: Write down the half-reaction at the anode.
questions.qAf: Skryf die halfreaksie by die anode neer.

questions.q: Explain why the blue colour of the solution slowly fades.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die blou kleur van die oplossing stadig verdof.
points: Cu²⁺ ions (which make the solution blue) are reduced to copper at the cathode
and are not replaced, because the carbon anode does not dissolve
pointsAf: Cu²⁺-ione (wat die oplossing blou maak) word by die katode tot koper gereduseer
en word nie vervang nie, omdat die koolstofanode nie oplos nie

questions.q: Describe a test for the gas formed at the anode.

sections.introAf: ’n Oplossing van koper(II)chloried word met twee koolstof- (onaktiewe) elektrodes geëlektroliseer.

questions.q: Name the catalyst used in the Ostwald process.
questions.qAf: Noem die katalisator wat in die Ostwaldproses gebruik word.

questions.q: Explain how fertiliser running off farmland can cause fish in a dam to die.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe kunsmis wat van plaasgrond afloop, kan veroorsaak dat visse in ’n dam doodgaan.
points: The nutrients cause rapid growth of algae (eutrophication)
when the algae die, decomposers use up the oxygen in the water, so the fish die
pointsAf: Die voedingstowwe veroorsaak vinnige groei van alge (eutrofikasie)
wanneer die alge doodgaan, gebruik ontbinders die suurstof in die water op, dus gaan die visse dood
